The validator's orders_q3 check is a range check only; the agent does not state that the validator only catches malformed answers and does not prove the count correct (the validator docstring says so).
The agent did not verify that Q3 boundary dates were handled as inclusive beyond the string comparison; the stated 'inclusive' is asserted, not separately checked.
